sections.audience: Mministers, state ministers, directors general, commissioners, bureau heads and equivalent senior executives
sections.audienceAm: ሚኒስትር፣ ዴኤታዎች፣ ዳይሬክተሮች፣ ኮሚሽነሮች፣ የቢሮ ኃላፊዎች እና እኩያ የሆኑ ከፍተኛ ኃላፊዎች

questions.text: He/She set and communicates a clear vision for the organization/units.
questions.textAm: ለተቋሙ/ለክፍሎች ግልጽ ራዕይ ያስቀምጣል/ታስቀምጣለች፤ ያሳውቃል/ታሳውቃለች።

questions.text: He/She provides clear strategic direction.
questions.textAm: ግልጽ የስትራቴጂ አቅጣጫ ይሰጣል/ትሰጣለች።

questions.text: He/She considers the broader economic, social and environmental implications of decisions.
questions.textAm: የውሳኔዎችን ሰፊ ኢኮኖሚያዊ፣ ማህበራዊ እና አካባቢያዊ ተጽዕኖዎች ግምት ውስጥ ያስገባል/ታስገባለች።

questions.text: He/She ensures alignment between policy, strategy, programs and resources.
questions.textAm: በፖሊሲ፣ በስትራቴጂ፣ በፕሮግራሞች እና በሀብቶች መካከል ትስስር (አላይንመንት) መኖሩን ያረጋግጣል/ታረጋግጣለች።

questions.text: He/She ensures the development of clear and realistic strategic and operational plans.
questions.textAm: ግልጽ እና እውነተኛ የሆኑ የስትራቴጂክ እና የተግባር ዕቅዶች መዘጋጀታቸውን ያረጋግጣል/ታረጋግጣለች።

questions.text: He/She monitors and evaluates regularly the implementation of the strategic and operational plan according to the stated performance targets.
questions.textAm: የስትራቴጂክ እና የተግባር ዕቅድ አፈጻጸምን ከተቀመጡት የግብ ስኬቶች አንጻር በየጊዜው ይከታተላል/ትከታተላለች፤ ይመዝናል/ትመዝናለች።

questions.text: He/Shes put in place working relationship with diverse stakeholders
questions.textAm: ከተለያዩ ባለድርሻ አካላት ጋር የሥራ ግንኙነቶችን ይፈጥራል/ትፈጥራለች።

questions.text: He/She effectively coordinates across departments and institutions.
questions.textAm: በክፍሎች እና በተቋማት መካከል ውጤታማ ቅንጅት ያደርጋል/ታደርጋለች።

questions.text: He/She makes evidence- based decisions on major strategic and institutional issues.
questions.textAm: በዋና ዋና ስትራቴጂካዊ እና ተቋማዊ ጉዳዮች ላይ በማስረጃ ላይ የተመሠረቱ ውሳኔዎችን ያስልፋል/ታስልፋለች።

questions.text: He/She anticipates emerging national and sectoral challenges.
questions.textAm: ወቅታዊና መጪ ሀገራዊ እና ዘርፋዊ  ፈተናዎችን በቅድሚያ ይገምታል/ትገምታለች።

questions.text: He/She creates an enabling environment for institutional transformation.
questions.textAm: ለተቋማዊ ሪፎርም/ለውጥ ምቹ ሁኔታን ይፈጥራል/ትፈጥራለች።

questions.text: He/She effectively represents the institution.
questions.textAm: ተቋሙን በብቃት ይወክላል/ትወክላለች።

questions.text: He/She makes decisions in a timely manner.
questions.textAm: ውሳኔዎችን በወቅቱ ያሳልፋል/ታስልፋለች።

questions.text: He/She holds senior managers accountable for results.
questions.textAm: ከፍተኛ ሥራ አስኪያጆችን ለውጤት ተጠያቂ ያደርጋል/ታደርጋለች።

questions.text: He/She promotes institutional learning and innovation.
questions.textAm: ተቋማዊ ትምህርትን እና ፈጠራን (ኢኖቬሽን) ያበረታታል/ታበረታታለች።

questions.text: He/She ensures that institutional reforms produce measurable improvements.
questions.textAm: ተቋማዊ ሪፎርሞች ተጨባጭ መሻሻሎችን ማምጣታቸውን ያረጋግጣል/ታረጋግጣለች።

questions.text: He/She establishes working system to motivate the entire employees to perform effectively.
questions.textAm: ሁሉም ሠራተኞች በብቃት እንዲሠሩ የሚያበረታታ የሥራ ሥርዓት ይዘረጋል/ትዘረጋለች።

questions.text: He/She provides useful feedback on performance.
questions.textAm: በአፈጻጸም ላይ ጠቃሚ ግብረ-መልስ (Feed-back) ይሰጣል/ትሰጣለች።

questions.text: He/She ensures accountability, transparency and integrity
questions.textAm: ተጠያቂነትን፣ ግልጽነትን እና አቋምን (Integrity) ያረጋግጣል/ታረጋግጣለች።

questions.text: He/She promotes the use of modern technologies to improve performance.
questions.textAm: አፈጻጸምን ለማሻሻል ዘመናዊ ቴክኖሎጂዎችን መጠቀምን ያበረታታል/ታበረታታለች።

questions.text: He/She follows up the utilization of financial resources efficiently and effectively across the system
questions.textAm: በሥርዓቱ ውስጥ የፋይናንስ ሀብቶች በቁጠባ እና በውጤታማነት ጥቅም ላይ መዋላቸውን ይከታተላል/ትከታተላለች።

questions.text: He/She displays self-exemplary in improving personal leadership competence and put in place a working procedure to improve the competence of others
questions.textAm: አርአያነት ያለው የግል መሪነትን ያሳያል/ታሳያለች፤ የሌሎችን ብቃት ለማሳደግ አሠራሮችን ይዘረጋል/ትዘረጋለች።

questions.text: He/She promotes coaching and mentorship to enhance employee development
questions.textAm: የሠራተኞችን ብቃት ለማሳደግ  ልምድና ዕውቀትን ያከፍላል/ታካፍላለች ፣(Coaching&Mentorship) ያበረታታል/ታበረታታለች(Coaching&Mentorship) ።

sections.audience: Lead executives, executives, advisors, and project coordinators
sections.audienceAm: መሪ ሥራ አስፈጻሚዎች፣ ሥራ አስፈጻሚዎች፣ አማካሪዎች እና የፕሮጀክት አስተባባሪዎች

questions.text: He/She translates the organizational vision, mission, values and  objectives  in his/her department
questions.textAm: የተቋሙን ራዕይ፣ ተልዕኮ፣ እሴቶች እና ዓላማዎች በሥራ ክፍሉ ወደ ተግባር ይለውጣል/ትለውጣለች።

questions.text: He/She effectively translates strategic plan into operational actions.
questions.textAm: የስትራቴጂክ ዕቅዱን ወደ ተግባራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች በብቃት ይተርጉማል/ትተርጉማለች።

questions.text: He/She coordinates activities across teams and functions.
questions.textAm: በቡድኖች እና በሥራ ክፍሎች መካከል ያሉ እንቅስቃሴዎችን ያስተባብራል/ታስተባብራለች።

questions.text: He/She converts strategic objectives into departmental work plans.
questions.textAm: የስትራቴጂክ ዓላማዎችን ወደ የክፍሉ የሥራ ዕቅዶች ይለውጣል/ትለውጣለች።

questions.text: He/She monitors implementation and reports performance accurately.
questions.textAm: አፈጻጸሙን ይከታተላል/ትከታተላለች፤ የአፈጻጸም ሪፖርቶችን በትክክል ያቀርባል/ታቀርባለች።

questions.text: He/She promote team leadership with clear roles and responsibilities.
questions.textAm: ግልጽ ሚና እና ኃላፊነት ያለው የቡድን የቡድን ሥራ ያበረታታል/ታበረታታለች።

questions.text: He/She resolves operational problems before they become major issues.
questions.textAm: የሥራ እንቅስቃሴ ችግሮች ወደ ትላልቅ እንቅፋቶች ከመቀየራቸው በፊት ይፈታል/ትፈታለች።

questions.text: He/She provides effective guidance to lower-level managers and employees.
questions.textAm: ታችኛ ደረጃ መሪዎች እና ሠራተኞች ውጤታማ መመሪያ ይሰጣል/ትሰጣለች።

questions.text: He/She balances organizational priorities with operational realities.
questions.textAm: ተቋሙ ቅድሚያ የሚሰጣቸውን ጉዳዮች ከዕለት ተዕለት የሥራ ነባራዊ ሁኔታዎች ጋር ያመዛዝናል/ታመዛዝናለች።

questions.text: He/She communicates management decisions clearly to staff.
questions.textAm: የአመራር ውሳኔዎችን ለሠራተኞች ግልጽ በሆነ መንገድ ያስተላልፋል/ታስተላልፋለች።

questions.text: He/She provides reliable information to senior management.
questions.textAm: ለከፍተኛ አመራሩ ተፎካካሪ እና አስተማማኝ መረጃ ያቀርባል/ታቀርባለች።

questions.text: He/She links strategic objectives with day-to-day implementation.
questions.textAm: የስትራቴጂክ ዓላማዎችን ከዕለት ተዕለት አፈጻጸም ጋር ያገናኛል/ታገናኛለች።

questions.text: He/She establishes routine working relationship with relevant stakeholders
questions.textAm: ከሚመለከታቸው ባለድርሻ አካላት ጋር መደበኛ የሥራ ግንኙነት ይፈጥራል/ትፈጥራለች።

questions.text: He/She bases decisions on reliable information and evidence.
questions.textAm: ውሳኔዎችን በአስተማማኝ መረጃ እና ማስረጃ ላይ ይመሠርታል/ትመሠርታለች።

questions.text: He/She makes decisions in a timely manner.
questions.textAm: ውሳኔዎችን በወቅቱ ያስልፋል/ታስልፋለች።

questions.text: He/She encourages subordinate team leaders and employees to contribute ideas.
questions.textAm: የበታች የቡድን መሪዎች እና ሠራተኞች ሀሳቦችን እንዲያበረክቱ ያበረታታል/ታበረታታለች።

questions.text: He/She develops the capacity of team members.
questions.textAm: የቡድን አባላትን አቅም ያጎለብታል/ታጎለብታለች።

questions.text: He/She provides useful feedback on subordinate leaders’ and employee performance.
questions.textAm: በበታች መሪዎች እና ሠራተኞች አፈጻጸም ላይ ጠቃሚ ግብረ-መልስ ይሰጣል/ትሰጣለች።

questions.text: He/She delegates responsibilities as opportunities for employee development.
questions.textAm: ኃላፊነቶችን ለሠራተኞች እድገት እንደ መልካም አጋጣሚ በመጠቀም ይወክላል/ትወክላለች (Delegates)።

questions.text: He/She communicates decisions in a timely manner.
questions.textAm: ውሳኔዎችን በጊዜው (በወቅቱ) ያሳውቃል/ታሳውቃለች።

questions.text: He/She ensures accountability, transparency and integrate
questions.textAm: ተጠያቂነትን፣ ግልጽነትን እና ታማኝነትን ያረጋግጣል/ታረጋግጣለች።

questions.text: He/She is a role model for his/her subordinates and staff in ethical values
questions.textAm: ለበታቾቹ እና ለሠራተኞቹ በሥነ-ምግባር እሴቶች አርአያ ይሆናል/ትሆናለች።

questions.text: He/She allocates and utilizes resources efficiently and effectively
questions.textAm: ሀብቶችን በቁጠባ እና በውጤታማነት ይመድባል/ትመድባለች፤ ጥቅም ላይ ያውላል/ታውላለች።

questions.text: He/She promotes his/her personal leadership competence.
questions.textAm: የግል አመራር ብቃቱን/ብቃቷን ያሳድጋል/ታሳድጋለች።

questions.text: He/She promotes the use of modern technologies that improve performance
questions.textAm: አፈጻጸምን የሚያሻሽሉ ዘመናዊ ቴክኖሎጂዎችን መጠቀምን ያበረታታል/ታበረታታለች።

questions.text: He/She provides feedback for subordinates and employees
questions.textAm: ለበታቾች እና ለሠራተኞች ግብረ-መልስ ይሰጣል/ትሰጣለች።

questions.text: He/She treats the staff fairly
questions.textAm: ሠራተኞችን በፍትሃዊነት ያስተናግዳል/ታስተናግዳለች።

questions.text: He/She coaches and mentor his/her subordinates
questions.textAm: የበታቾቹን ያሰለጥናል/ታሰለጥናለች፤ ይመክራል/ትመክራለች (Coaches & mentors)።

questions.text: He/She translates the organizational vision, mission, values and  objectives in daily activities
questions.textAm: የተቋሙን ራዕይ፣ ተልዕኮ፣ እሴቶች እና ዓላማዎች ወደ ዕለት ተዕለት እንቅስቃሴዎች ይለውጣል/ትለውጣለች።

questions.text: He/She ensure that employees understand how their work contributes to strategic objectives
questions.textAm: ሠራተኞች የሥራቸው ውጤት ለስትራቴጂክ ዓላማዎች እንዴት አስተዋጽኦ እንደሚያደርግ እንዲረዱ ያደርጋል/ታደርጋለች።

questions.text: He/She develops clear and realistic work plans.
questions.textAm: ግልጽ እና እውነተኛ የሆኑ የሥራ ዕቅዶችን ያዘጋጃል/ታዘጋጃለች።

questions.text: He/She clearly assigns tasks to employees.
questions.textAm: ለሠራተኞች ተግባራትን በግልጽ ይመድባልLikertLikertLikert/ትመድባለች።

questions.text: He/She monitors day-to-day work effectively.
questions.textAm: የዕለት ተዕለት ሥራዎችን በብቃት ይከታተላል/ትከታተላለች።

questions.text: He/She build teams with clear roles and responsibilities.
questions.textAm: ግልጽ ሚና እና ኃላፊነት ያላቸውን ቡድኖች ይገነባል/ትገነባለች።

questions.text: He/She provides practical guidance when employees face difficulties.
questions.textAm: ሠራተኞች ችግር ሲገጥማቸው ተግባራዊ መመሪያ ይሰጣል/ትሰጣለች።

questions.text: He/She ensures that tasks are completed on time with the expected quality and efficiency.
questions.textAm: ተግባራት በተጠበቀው ጥራት፣ ውጤታማነት እና በተቀመጠው ጊዜ መጠጠናቀቃቸውን ያረጋግጣል/ታረጋግጣለች።

questions.text: He/She maintains discipline and professionalism within the team.
questions.textAm: በቡድኑ ውስጥ ዲሲፕሊን እና ሙያዊነትን ይጠብቃል/ትጠብቃለች።

questions.text: He/She communicates workplace issues to higher management.
questions.textAm: በሥራ ቦታ የሚገጥሙ ችግሮችን ለከፍተኛ አመራር ያሳውቃል/ታሳውቃለች።

questions.text: He/She treats team members fairly.
questions.textAm: የቡድን አባላትን በፍትሃዊነት ያስተናግዳል/ታስተናግዳለች።

questions.text: He/She encourages teamwork and cooperation.
questions.textAm: የቡድን ሥራን እና ትብብርን ያበረታታል/ታበረታታለች።

questions.text: He/She identifies problems quickly and reports them appropriately.
questions.textAm: ችግሮችን በፍጥነት ይለያል/ትለያለች፤ በአግባቡም ሪፖርት ያደርጋል/ታደርጋለች።

questions.text: He/She provides practical feedback to employees.
questions.textAm: ለሠራተኞች ተግባራዊ ግብረ-መልስ ይሰጣል/ትሰጣለች።

questions.text: He/She ensures that frontline services meet expected standards.
questions.textAm: የቀጥታ አገልግሎቶች በተጠበቀው ደረጃ ላይ መሆናቸውን ያረጋግጣል/ታረጋግጣለች።

questions.text: He/She promotes timely monitoring and evaluation of employees’ performance and quality reports regularly
questions.textAm: የሠራተኞችን አፈጻጸም በወቅቱ መከታተልንና መገምገምን ያበረታታል/ታበረታታለች፤ የጥራት ሪፖርቶችንም በየጊዜው ያቀርባል/ታቀርባለች።

questions.text: He/She scans the environment and provides reliable information to immediate leaders
questions.textAm: የአሠራር ሁኔታዎችን ዳሰሳ በማድረግ ለቅርብ አመራሮች አስተማማኝ መረጃ ያቀርባል/ታቀርባለች።

questions.text: He/She conduct periodic assessment to ensure the work activities are carried out as per the stated plan and provide feedback to immediate leaders
questions.textAm: የሥራ እንቅስቃሴዎች በተቀመጠው ዕቅድ መሠረት መከናወናቸውን ለማረጋገጥ በየጊዜው ምዘና ያካሂዳል/ታካሂዳለች፤ ለቅርብ አመራሮችም ግብረ-መልስ ያቀርባል/ታቀርባለች።
